workload.note: Missed first 6 games to NFL suspension (returned ~Week 7, Oct 19, 2025); season ended early after a knee injury required surgery. Also had 5 carries for 20 yards and 1 rushing TD. 8 games played total per ESPN game log (Oct 19-Dec 14, 2025).
Season cut short: suffered a knee injury Week 4 (Oct 3, 2024) in a collision with Patrick Mahomes vs. Chargers; placed on IR. Full-season stat line not verified in sources checked.

contract.note: Entering final year of his rookie contract (2023 2nd-round pick) in 2026. No extension agreed as of July 29, 2026; Chiefs have limited cap space (~$4.12M) and are 'hesitant' on an extension given his legal issues, per Athlon (July 29, 2026). Comparable top WRs (e.g., Jaxon Smith-Njigba) earn ~$42M/year, suggesting significant earning potential if he performs and stays out of trouble.

notes: March 2024: hit-and-run incident in Dallas; Rice and four others left scene without checking on occupants of other vehicles, two of whom were hospitalized.
July 2025: pleaded guilty to two felony charges; sentenced to 30 days jail + 5 years probation.
2025 season: NFL suspended Rice 6 games (personal conduct policy) for the hit-and-run.

Oct 2025 (reported ~April 2026): ex-girlfriend Dacoda Jones filed a civil suit alleging repeated domestic abuse; an Oct 9, 2025 affidavit has Jones stating under penalty of perjury that Rice did not punch her, though a verbal argument occurred. No criminal charges filed. NFL concluded (per report published ~April 2026) that Rice 'has not engaged in conduct that violates the personal conduct policy' and issued no additional suspension.
May 19, 2026: arrested in Dallas for failing a drug test while on probation (violating probation tied to the 2024 case).
Rice was subsequently sentenced to serve additional jail time for the probation violation; released from Dallas County Jail June 16, 2026.
Rice did not participate in 2026 OTAs or mandatory minicamp, due to the jail sentence and knee recovery.

injury.status: Recovering from right knee debridement (clean-up) surgery; progressing well in camp
